title: World Bank Group Website Accessibility Statement
summary: The World Bank Group provides a statement outlining its commitment to website accessibility and the measures in place to ensure the site is usable for individuals with disabilities.
body:
The World Bank Group provides a statement outlining its commitment to website accessibility and the measures in place to ensure the site is usable for individuals with disabilities.

Read more from the original source: [news.google.com](https://www.albankaldawli.org/ar/who-we-are/site-accessibility)
